title: Is Your Organization Effective? | Principles of Management Ep 28
description:
Chai Corner started as one stall, with Ravi doing everything alone. Now it has five outlets and a head office. But is it actually doing well? Kabir says sales are up, Asha asks about the staff, and Meena asks about the customers. In this series finale we find out how to judge a whole organization.

You will learn what organizational effectiveness means (how well an organization achieves its goals), the difference between effectiveness (doing the right things) and efficiency (doing things right), the four approaches to measuring effectiveness (goal attainment, system resource, internal process, and the stakeholder or strategic constituencies approach), and six common indicators: profit, productivity, customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, growth and adaptability. Then we look back at Ravi's whole journey and give Chai Corner its final scorecard.

This is Episode 28, the final episode of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
